purpose: Order 117 hypothesis-2 environment-recovery A/B: run the same reusable ZIP and post-conversion-context candidate after removing an invalid cross-install Python import discovered before the first model request.
change_scope: Keep the complete v123 hypothesis-2 semantics, prompt, model, tool contract, runtime limits, evaluator, VM, and model-owned arguments unchanged. Replace only the Multi-Apps schema dependency on a separately installed os_adapter Python package with a package-local shared validator that enforces the same archive mode and path contract. This permits the independently installed generic Multi-Apps service to start. No task identity, instruction fingerprint, filename constant, answer, golden content, evaluator state, Runner rerouting, or argument rewriting participates.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this hypothesis-2 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most one further materially different generic hypothesis with one targeted A/B. If hypothesis 3 also fails, mark Order 117 task_blocked and immediately advance to Order 118.

implementation_evidence.environment_parent_diagnosis: The v123 guest OS Adapter deployed the archive module, but the independently installed generic Multi-Apps service crashed at import time because generic_schema imported os_adapter.schema and that separate install directory is not on the service PYTHONPATH. Multi-Apps health timed out with ModuleNotFoundError before setup completed. The run was stopped after the first confirmed deploy failure instead of waiting through identical retries; it is preserved as interrupted, with zero steps and zero model or Adapter calls, so it does not consume a generic hypothesis A/B slot.
implementation_evidence.candidate_bundle_hash_method: SHA-256 of the ordered sha256sum lines for the 14 modified production modules listed above.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 297 Multi-Apps generic runtime, legacy schema, and strict manifest tests passed after the install-boundary correction; the complete unit suite reported 1807 passed. An isolated temporary install containing only multi_apps_adapter loaded the deployed generic schema and parsed archive.create_extract without os_adapter on PYTHONPATH. Ruff, changed-file format, compileall, project layout, generic deployment leakage, frozen-v1 hashes, and OSWorld commit/evaluator-tree checks passed.

Four additional invalid create/extract combinations prove that the package-local facade validator rejects missing input_paths, relative extraction targets, non-ZIP outputs, and cross-mode base_directory use.
